dict.string: Gyro needs access to your Desktop so you can open projects and attach files kept there.
Gyro needs access to your Documents folder so you can open projects stored there.
Gyro needs access to your Downloads folder so you can open cloned repositories and downloaded archives.
Gyro needs access to external volumes so you can work on repositories kept on removable drives.
Gyro needs access to network volumes so you can work on repositories kept on shared drives.
Gyro needs access to cloud-synced folders such as iCloud Drive so you can open projects stored there.
